statement: A configured raft peer's address and the current leader's address are answered from the committed configuration and the live raft status, never from the CDC-fed services or message_groups cache or a bootstrap hint list. The message-group RESOLVE_PEER_ADDRESS binding formats the address on the peer's committed node (the port's second argument) or refuses typed peer_not_in_configuration; message-group founders commit founderNodeIds in their GENESIS stamp; every ADD (partition and message group ADD_PEER, and the FreshMG managed ADD_LEARNER) commits one context shape carrying {replicaIdentity, peerId, nodeId}, with no decoder for a context without nodeId; the message-group forwarding leader is the live raft leader; the partition leader address for write forwarding is answered from raft.readStatus() only, with typed NOT_LEADER/NO_LEADER. buildPeerAddress, the message-group and partition resolvePeerAddressFromCache, the bootstrap hint resolution, the peerAddresses hint plumbing, the leader-id hint and the cache-derived canonical leader identity are deleted.

constraints.statement: Instances C3 (message-group half), C4 and U11 of the class 'a serve-gating decision consumes a projection as if it were committed authority' (census solve/epics/raft-rs-full-cutover/evidence/projection-authority-census-2026-11-02/CENSUS.md on origin/work/projection-authority-census-20261102; analysis docs/evidence/comparative-benchmark-evidence-repair-2026-11/systemic-analysis-serve-lane-2026-11-01.md). The repair moves each decision onto the committed fact; it adds no timer, retry, carve-out, cache wait, hint merge or alternate resolution path and deletes the existing ones for these decisions.

Continues owner decisions O1/A8 (design-committed-membership-bootstrap-read-2026-09-25.md) and the repaired partition half (quest learner-host-from-committed-admission): rows are discovery, never authority; expectedPeersFromServicesCache stays only as the A8 discovery trigger of a host-proposed ADD; the address of a configured peer is the committed node recorded at apply and read back through the raft-rs runtime owner.

Lead decision D-C3 (R08): one canonical committed peer-context shape. Every ADD, partition and message group, ADD_PEER and the FreshMG managed ADD_LEARNER, commits {replicaIdentity, peerId, nodeId}; the FreshMG managed context gains nodeId as a managed key; no old-format decoder (in-place upgrade unsupported, ruling 2026-10-04). Supersedes the bounded ruling of the learner quest that the learner_admission codec stays untouched. A second entry carrying the context after ADD_LEARNER is rejected.

Rejected remedies (census C3/C4) must not return: cache-first ordering as a correctness rule; merged bootstrap hints; waiting for the services row; any learner_address_unresolvable-style refusal asking a peer to re-assert a row; a bounded authoritative re-read; hint-derived leader identity.

Every src/ change lands only behind an independent subagent verification newer than the last attempt, naming the reviewed heads. Attempt 1 (message-group half, U11, D-C3) is verified before attempt 2 (C4) begins; attempt 2 starts only after merging the then-current head of origin/work/replica-admission-committed-operation-20261102 and stops if its hunks collide semantically with that stream.

Heavy suites and any scenario witness run on the lab (node scripts/lab.js) when the fleet is free, never concurrently with another load; local runs are one classified lane at a time behind the thermal headroom check.
